profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer @ Aktion Associates | Helping Distributors Modernize ERP Systems | SQL | Phocas Reporting & MITS BI | Data Migration | Progress ABL
profile.summary:
I help distributors and wholesale businesses modernize their ERP systems by bridging the gap between business operations and technology.

As a Principal Software Engineer at Aktion Associates, I partner with customers to transition from legacy ERP environments to cloud-based solutions. My focus is on understanding business processes, cleaning and validating data, developing SQL-based reporting, and ensuring customers have the information they need to make confident business decisions.

My experience spans ERP implementations, data migration, SQL reporting, business intelligence, and analytics using tools like Phocas and MITS. I also have experience with Progress ABL development and continue expanding my technical expertise in Java and Python to build more robust solutions.

Before moving into software and ERP consulting, I spent six years in project management, working directly with executive leadership to improve operations across finance, purchasing, accounting, IT, and our supply chain. This operational background helps me understand challenges from the customer’s perspective and translate complex technical concepts into practical business solutions.

I enjoy solving problems, improving processes, and helping organizations get the most value from their technology investments. Whether it’s optimizing data, building meaningful reports, or guiding a successful cloud migration, my goal is to make technology work for the people who rely on it every day.

I’m always interested in connecting with professionals in ERP consulting, business intelligence, cloud ERP, data analytics, and enterprise software.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Collaborated directly with the President to ensure seamless operations across all departments using the Infor ERP system. Supported senior managers in Purchasing, Accounting, IT, and Operations by resolving technical challenges, generating detailed reports, and refining procedural workflows. Played a pivotal role in driving operational efficiency and aligning processes with organizational goals.
